run_DETR_R18_training: run DETR object detection training with ResNet-18 backbone on COCO dataset using 500 epochs
configure_DETR_backbone: configure DETR model to use ResNet-18 backbone with pretrained ImageNet weights via torchvision
update_model_config: update the DETR model config to change backbone depth from 50 to 18 and adjust neck channels
load_base_config: load the base DETR ResNet-50 config and override backbone settings for a lighter model
summarize_DETR_config: summarize the DETR ResNet-18 configuration that extends the ResNet-50 base config with modified backbone and neck
